text:
kari: Heads-up from this morning's enterprise security call. Customer asked three items for the SQ: 1) Can we provide ephemeral SSH/jumpbox access for IR with tenant scoping? 2) What's our SLA for notifying about confirmed exploit IOCs? 3) Can they receive verifiable signed snapshots of logs for eDiscovery? Need short SQ-safe answers + runbook pointers.

ben: Ephemeral jumpbox: yes. We offer tenant-scoped ephemeral bastion sessions that are time-limited and require justification. Sessions are created via Console > Access > Investigations and issue short-lived certs (ssh-cert) tied to an investigator principal. All commands are recorded and streamed to audit. Example: `ssh -i /tmp/investigator-cert.pem user@jump.tenant.redwood`

emily: add that we can restrict jumpbox network egress to customer VPC ranges for Private deployments, and for Hosted we enforce egress via our audited proxy. Important to say we do not place customer secrets on the jumpbox filesystem; all access is mediated and logged.

oncall: SLA/IOC notify: we have tiered notifications. For customers with an SLA addendum we provide email + secure channel alerts within 24h of confirmed exploitation indicators; general practice is notification as soon as confirmed and a remediation plan within 72h for high-severity. Keep SQ wording non-binding: "timely notification and prioritized remediation guidance" but note addenda possible.

kari: log snapshots / signed proofs: what can we offer?

ben: we can produce a signed snapshot bundle containing redacted events and a signed root (HSM-signed). For tenants with BYOK we can anchor the snapshot hash to their CMK so they can independently verify integrity. Snapshots include a manifest with chain-hash + export metadata (time range, requester, justification).

emily: operational caveat: ad-hoc historical snapshot generation is gated and may require PS for very large ranges due to compute and privacy review. Also, we rotate the snapshot signing key on a schedule; we include signer key metadata so customers can validate historical signatures.

oncall: runbook pointer: runbook/ir/ephemeral-access-and-snapshots (internal). Also note export actions generate audit events: `export.snapshot.create` with fields (actor, tenant, range, manifest_hash).

kari: customer also asked if RBAC changes that widen access to 'investigator' role require approvals and if exports are reviewed.

ben: policy: any role grant that enables investigator-level access requires one approver from Security and one from the tenant's Admin (if in Dedicated/Private). For Hosted customers, Security + Platform approver. Exports created by investigator roles are subject to an automated pre-export redaction check and queued for post-export audit review if flagged.

emily: add the SIEM delivery note: we can stream snapshots or event subsets via s3 presigned transfer, SFTP, or mTLS webhook. We support signed bundle delivery over customer-managed endpoints.

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-10121 (owner: ben)  due: EOD+3 for SQ text + runbook updates.

kari: please draft the 3 short SQ bullets: ephemeral jumpbox + RBAC approvals, SLA/IOC notify, and signed snapshot proof. Keep customer-facing, non-technical. Also include contact sec-eng@redwood.com for PS.

ben: DRAFT SQ bullets:
- Ephemeral investigative access: Redwood can issue tenant-scoped, time-limited investigative access (ephemeral jumpbox or short-lived certs). Sessions are recorded and scoped to customer resources; network egress can be restricted for Private deployments.
- Incident notification SLA: Redwood provides prioritized notification and mitigation guidance for confirmed exploitation indicators. Customers with SLA addenda can receive accelerated alerts and tailored communication channels.
- Verifiable audit snapshots: Redwood can produce signed, tamper-evident snapshot bundles of redacted audit events. For BYOK customers we can bind snapshot integrity proofs to a customer key for independent verification. Ad-hoc historical exports may require professional services.

kari: awesome. emily, please add the transfer methods (SFTP/S3/webhook) to the docs PR. ben, update runbook and paste link here. i'll send the SQ reply after the PR merges. :thumbsup:

oncall: Note for oncall: ensure investigator cert TTL defaults & max are documented (default 1h, max 12h) and that export queueing is rate-limited to prevent spikes.

sec-bot: Reminder: SEC-10121 created.
